images.role: the plate as 8-bit display sRGB frames (the node's image input through the working-to-sRGB display transform), at least 8 frames; resized to 512 wide like upstream MASt3R-SLAM

intrinsics.role: MASt3R-SLAM is uncalibrated: it tracks on MASt3R's per-pixel rays and returns the focal length it finds (the node's focal is not used; its vertical aperture turns the focal from pixels into millimetres)

seed.role: torch, numpy and CUDA seed; the solver runs in one process (its back end inline), so the order of work is fixed

loop_closure.role: the retrieval database that adds loop edges between keyframes, on (1) or off (0, only consecutive keyframes)

returns.poses: camera-to-world 4x4 per frame, OpenCV axes (x right, y down, z forward), up to scale; each frame is its keyframe's optimised pose times its pose relative to that keyframe, refined by a bundle adjustment of the tracker's matches with the focal held
returns.intrinsics: fx, fy, cx, cy in plate pixels: the focal fitted to the keyframes' point maps (median over keyframes), square pixels, the principal point at the centre
returns.points: dense keyframe point maps, confident pixels on a 4-pixel grid, solve units, 8-bit colour, at most 60000
returns.scale: the solve is monocular: scale comes from the node's unit_scale or two surveyed points

environment.gpu: NVIDIA card through CUDA only (RTX 3080 Ti, 12 GB)
models: naver MASt3R retrieval trainingfree.pth (8 MB) and codebook.pkl (268 MB), loop closure only
